title: Incorrect condition for setting HTTP status name
detail: The code only attempts to set the status name if cls.name is already truthy, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. This prevents subclasses that define a custom code but no name from having their name automatically filled from HTTPStatus.
note: Describes the planted negation: the name is set only when there already is one.

title: Missing import of Request
detail: The added type hint references Request, but the module does not import Request, leading to a NameError at import time.

title: Passing Request to run_wsgi_app
detail: The `from_app` method accepts a Request object as environ, but then passes it directly to `run_wsgi_app`, which expects a WSGIEnvironment. This will raise a TypeError or unexpected behavior.

title: Incorrect no_proxy domain boundary logic
detail: The condition `if hostname != host or host_with_port == host:` incorrectly returns True when the hostname does not match the no_proxy entry, causing legitimate requests to be bypassed. The logic should check for equality or suffix match, not inequality.

title: Incorrect no_proxy domain boundary check
detail: The condition incorrectly returns True when the hostname does not match the no_proxy host, causing URLs like http://prelocalhost/ to be incorrectly bypassed. The intended logic is to bypass only when the hostname matches the no_proxy entry or the host_with_port matches it.

title: Modifier bits added for modifier keys
detail: The condition uses `or`, causing modifier bits to be added even when the key itself is a modifier key. Modifier keys should not have redundant modifier bits reported.

title: Incorrect handling of coroutine stat_file
detail: The second argument to _maybeDeferred_coro is set to False, indicating that the function is not a coroutine. If self.store.stat_file is an async coroutine (as the tests patch it to be), this call will return a coroutine object instead of a Deferred, leading to type errors when the result is used as a Deferred. The coroutine will never be awaited, causing the pipeline to hang or crash.
note: `_maybeDeferred_coro`'s second parameter is `warn`, not whether the function is a coroutine, and it turns a coroutine into a Deferred either way.

title: Blocking queue get without await
detail: The loader coroutine uses a synchronous `get()` on an asyncio queue, which blocks the event loop and causes the loader to hang. The correct call is `await load_queue.get()`.
